content: Google OAuth cannot be restricted to multiple external email domains in Google Cloud Console (that only works for Google Workspace internal orgs). True server-side enforcement requires a Postgres trigger on auth.users (BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE) that checks email domain against an allowlist table and raises an exception to reject the row; trigger fires for all auth methods including OAuth. Store allowed domains in a table (not hardcoded), lowercase-normalize before comparing, use SECURITY DEFINER with SET search_path = ''. Client-side domain check alone is bypassable and must not be the only gate.
